description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements a logging node that wraps Android's native Log utility, serving as part of a chain of logging nodes to facilitate flexible logging output in an Android application.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native logging utility to allow log messages to be passed along a chain of log nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain for subsequent log message passing.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message using Android's Log mechanism, with optional exception information, then forwards the log to the next node if any.
